recognize_zh: 中倍下一個反應性濾泡，有淡染生發中心與完整深染外套層，濾泡周圍與外套層邊緣散布淡嗜伊紅的小群類上皮組織球，並向濾泡侵入，這種排列是弓漿蟲淋巴結炎的特徵。
features: Reactive follicle with a pale germinal center and a well-preserved dark mantle zone of small lymphocytes
Germinal center contains mixed centroblasts, centrocytes and histiocytes
Small loose clusters of epithelioid histiocytes with pale pink cytoplasm scattered in the perifollicular tissue and encroaching on the mantle and germinal center
Interfollicular zone with small lymphocytes, paler cells and small vessels
No necrosis, well-formed granulomas or giant cells
describe_en: H&E section of lymph node shows a reactive follicle with a polarized germinal center and an intact mantle zone. Small, poorly formed clusters of epithelioid histiocytes are scattered around the follicle and encroach on the mantle and germinal center. There is no necrosis and no well-formed granulomas or giant cells. Findings are consistent with toxoplasma lymphadenitis; serologic confirmation is recommended.

ddx.vs: Ordinary follicular hyperplasia lacks the small epithelioid histiocyte clusters encroaching on germinal centers.
Infectious granulomas are larger and well circumscribed with giant cells and often necrosis, and organisms can be shown with AFB or GMS stains.
NLPHL shows large expansile nodules with CD20-positive LP (popcorn) cells and may have epithelioid histiocytes at the nodule periphery, rather than small reactive follicles.
